release_notes.headline_internal: Latency benchmarks now use median regression checks instead of a mislabeled maximum, preventing shared-runner scheduling stalls from failing trunk
highlights: Both semantic and symbol latency benchmarks retain their existing strict 100ms and 50ms regression budgets across ten calls.
A single scheduling outlier no longer decides CI; uniform slowdowns still fail the same budgets.
A separate strict 1000ms per-sample hang guard catches pathological blocking without claiming a tail-latency SLA.
